name: LinearEquiv.isFiniteLength
statement: M ≃ₗ[R] N) (h : IsFiniteLength R M) : IsFiniteLength R N

name: isFiniteLength_of_exists_compositionSeries
statement: ∃ s : CompositionSeries (Submodule R M), s.head = ⊥ ∧ s.last = ⊤) : IsFiniteLength R M

name: IsSemisimpleModule.finite_tfae
statement: List.TFAE [Module.Finite R M, IsNoetherian R M, IsArtinian R M, IsFiniteLength R M, ∃ s : Set (Submodule R M), s.Finite ∧ sSupIndep s ∧ sSup s = ⊤ ∧ ∀ m ∈ s, IsSimpleModule R m]
